text: # Company Policy ## Leave Policy Employees are eligible for paid annual leave of 20 days. Employees must apply for
leave in advance. Managers must approve leave requests. ## Attendance Policy Employees must arrive at the office on time. Working
hours are from 9 AM to 6 PM. Employees must inform their manager about late arrival. ## Work From Home
Policy Employees can work from home with manager approval. Employees must attend all scheduled online meetings.
